newsitem.title: USA: Harken contracts Parker rigs in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Harken contracts Parker rigs in Colombia.

text.p: Harken Energy Corp said Wednesday it entered into a long-term drilling contract, which includes evergreen extension options, with Parker Drilling Co.

Harken said it now has two rigs under continuous drilling contracts and contemplates that these drilling rigs will be used to accelerate the company's previously announced drilling program in Colombia.

Parker will furnish a fully-equipped rig for use on Harken's Association Contract acreage in the Middle Magdalena Valley and Llanos areas of Colombia that has capacity to drill exploratory and development wells on all four Association Contracts held by Harken, the company said.

"We currently plan for the first well to be drilled under this long-term contract to be the offset well to the previously announced Estcro 1 discovery (Palo Blanco) on the Alcaravan contract acreage," Harken said.
"Our drilling activity level will increase dramatically as we manage continuous drilling efforts for two rigs."
